name: Closed-cell spray foam
description: Two-component closed-cell polyurethane spray foam, about R-7 per inch, 2 pcf; also an air and vapor retarder. Must be covered by a thermal barrier such as 1/2in drywall inside a building.
source: Huntsman Heatlok HFO EZ data sheet (23.00144 V6): density 2.0-2.3 pcf (ASTM D1622), aged R 7.0 at 1in; ICC-ES ESR-4073 nominal 2.0 pcf

name: Open-cell spray foam
description: Low-density open-cell spray foam, about R-3.8 per inch, 0.5 pcf, usually installed by a contractor 3-1/2in or more deep. Air-seals but is vapor-open; needs a thermal barrier inside a building.
source: Huntsman Sealection 500 data sheet (20.00085): density 0.50 pcf (ASTM D1622), R 3.81 at 1in

name: Polyethylene vapor barrier, 6 mil
description: 6 mil polyethylene sheeting: vapor retarder under slabs, over crawlspace soil, or on the warm side of walls in cold climates.
source: Estimate: 0.1524mm (6 mil) x low-density polyethylene about 920 kg/m³ = 0.14 kg/m² (about 29 lb per 1,000 sq ft); no roll weight found

name: Ductless mini-split, 12,000 BTU
description: Single-zone ductless mini-split heat pump, 12,000 BTU: wall-mounted indoor unit, outdoor condenser and line set. For the materials list only, not simulated; usually installed by a licensed HVAC tech (refrigerant handling).
source: Pioneer WYS012AMFI20RL: indoor unit 20 lb net, 31.57 x 7.44 x 11.69in; outdoor unit 62.2 lb net, 30.3 x 11.8 x 21.8in (retailer spec). Effective density: 82.2 lb over the two boxes combined (6.10 cu ft)

name: Bathroom exhaust fan, 80 CFM
description: Ceiling-mounted bathroom exhaust fan, about 80 CFM, ducted to the outside (not into the attic). For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Broan-NuTone AE80B housing 9-1/4 x 10 x 5-3/4in (broan-nutone.com). Estimate: about 7 lb (spec-sheet weight not retrieved) over that housing

name: Gable vent
description: Louvered gable-end attic vent (vinyl or aluminum, about 12 x 18in) with insect screen. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 2 lb over a 12 x 18 x 2in box (no maker weight found)

name: Silicone sealant (10 oz tube)
description: 100% silicone sealant, 10.1 oz cartridge: tubs, showers, windows and other non-paintable joints.
source: Estimate: 10.1 fl oz (299 mL) x specific gravity about 1.04 plus about 40g cartridge = about 0.77 lb, over a 2 x 2 x 8.75in cartridge box (no maker weight retrieved)

name: Polyurethane sealant (10 oz tube)
description: Polyurethane construction sealant, 10.1 oz cartridge (Sikaflex-1a class): exterior joints, concrete and masonry; paintable.
source: Estimate: 10.1 fl oz (299 mL) x specific gravity about 1.2 plus about 40g cartridge = about 0.88 lb, over a 2 x 2 x 8.75in cartridge box (no maker weight retrieved)

name: Construction adhesive (10 oz tube)
description: Polyurethane construction adhesive, 10 oz cartridge (PL Premium class), for subfloors, sill plates and landscape block. Not counted as structural in the solver.
source: Estimate: 10 fl oz (296 mL) x specific gravity about 1.45 plus about 40g cartridge = about 1.0 lb, over a 2 x 2 x 8.75in cartridge box (no maker weight retrieved)

name: Liquid waterproofing membrane
description: Roll-on liquid waterproofing membrane (Custom RedGard class) over cement board in showers and wet areas; two coats to the maker's thickness, about 55 sq ft per gallon.
source: Custom Building Products RedGard product page: 55 sq ft per gallon as a waterproofing membrane (40 as an A118.10 pan liner). Estimate: about 10.5 lb/gal wet at 60% solids = about 0.12 psf cured (TDS-104 not retrieved)
